messages:
maria-docs: Quick micro-sync: we need a tiny migration checklist and a 3-snippet smoke job to catch obvious v1->v2 breakage. Keep it minimal.

tom-sdk: I can scan samples for client.v1 usages and swap to v2. Quick grep: rg "client\.v1" --hidden || true

priya-qa: Propose CI job docs/snippet-lite that runs 3 snippets: python, node, go. Save stdout+exitcode to artifacts/docs/snippet-lite/<thread_ts>.

lucy-dev: Note: TS streaming example often breaks; include a streaming signature test (old onmessage vs new onChunk).

sam-sdk: I'll add a CHANGELOG blurb and emit a console.warn from the v1 shim with the retirement date.

noah-web: Web ops will add a temporary redirect /v1/* -> /docs/migrate-v2 (302). Ticket WEB-9123 created.

ci-bot: CI job docs/snippet-lite queued by @priya-qa

priya-qa: Run done: 2/3 passed. Node streaming failed with old callback. Log at artifacts/docs/snippet-lite/1743211111/node-stream.log

maria-docs: Thanks. I'll open a small docs PR to update the Node streaming snippet and call out the mapping.

tom-sdk: I'll follow with sample app PRs.

maria-docs: Owners: docs @maria-docs; SDK @tom-sdk; CI @priya-qa; web @noah-web. Target: merge fixes by EOD Wed, announce after redirects are staged.

sam-sdk: Sounds good ":)"
